James Madison University's School of Art, Design, and Art History is seeking a Tenure-Track Assistant Professor of Architectural Design for our Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) program in Architectural Design. The position is a full-time, 10-month academic appointment. The successful candidate will have an appointment starting August 10, 2027 teaching architectural design studios and lecture/seminar classes. We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic candidate who will engage with a collaborative community, encourage independent thought and creativity, embrace cultural expression, and promote excellence in the making, practice, and comprehension of architectural design.
School of Art, Design, and Art History Overview:
Our dynamic, energetic, and engaging School of Art Design and Art History employs nearly 60 full-time and part-time faculty and staff serving approximately over 620 full-time majors enrolled in B.A., B.S., B.F.A., and M.F.A., degree programs, including Studio Art, Graphic Design, Architectural Design, Industrial Design, and Art History, with Art Education certification, and minors in Art, Art History, Book Arts, and Illustration. The school also offers the Master of Fine Arts degree, a nationally ranked program by U.S. News and World Report. SADAH’s mission is to collaborate as creators and scholars to advance independent thought through rigorous practice and research. For information about the SADAH, please visit www.jmu.edu/art.
Duties and Responsibilities:
The candidate needs to be qualified to teach courses in materials, representation, visualization, and digital techniques, as well as architectural history and theory relevant to contemporary architectural design. Knowledge of contemporary global issues and practices in design is essential. The candidate will employ skills ranging from research, craft, hand-drawing, software proficiency, and digital and analog fabrication processes with a concentration on hybrid techniques. In addition, the role of mentorship to undergraduate students is expected along with service to the design profession and academic community at JMU. Alongside teaching, other duties will require curriculum development, advising, and active participation in departmental and college-wide service initiatives.
We invite candidates committed to contributing to the development and direction of our growing program. Candidates are encouraged to visit the Architectural Design web page at https://www.jmu.edu/artandarthistory/programs/architectural-design.shtml and our Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/jmuarcd/ for more information about our program.
